variety.label: Modern Standard Arabic
variety.policyNoteEnglish: Dictionary citation forms are third-person masculine singular past. The course teaches all thirteen person/gender/number slots in past and present indicative. Fully vocalized formal forms, including indicative endings, are assessed. Weak verbs use explicit authored tables; there is no runtime conjugator.

review.noteEnglish: Original AI-authored and AI self-reviewed MSA paradigms. Qualified native-speaker and audible speech review are required; no independent or human approval is claimed.
